clauses.clause_label: Section 3(a)(1)-(3) — attribution and sharing adapted material
clauses.scope_note: Applies when the licensee shares the Licensed Material. Retain the specified information if supplied by the Licensor, including creator and designated attribution identification, copyright and license notices, warranty-disclaimer notice, and a reasonably practicable URI or hyperlink. The conditions may be satisfied in any reasonable manner suited to the medium, means, and context. If the Licensor requests, remove information required by Section 3(a)(1)(A) to the extent reasonably practicable. Sharing Adapted Material is not permitted under this Public License.
clauses.condition_explanation: The notice and modification-indication duties apply upon sharing. The Licensor-requested removal duty applies only if requested and only to the reasonably practicable extent. No separate permission to share adaptations is supplied.

clauses.scope_note: For Licensed Material where the Licensed Rights include applicable Sui Generis Database Rights, the clause grants extraction, reuse, reproduction, and sharing of all or a substantial portion of database contents only for NonCommercial purposes and provided Adapted Material is not shared. Including all or a substantial portion of the contents in a database in which the licensee has Sui Generis Database Rights makes that database, but not its individual contents, Adapted Material. Sharing all or a substantial portion triggers Section 3(a) conditions. This supplements obligations for other Copyright and Similar Rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: The grant applies only if the Licensed Rights include database rights that apply to the use. NonCommercial purpose and not sharing Adapted Material are cumulative conditions; sharing all or a substantial portion also requires compliance with Section 3(a).

clauses.scope_note: The Public License applies for the term of the licensed Copyright and Similar Rights. On failure to comply, the licensee's rights terminate automatically. Terminated rights reinstate automatically on the date the violation is cured if cured within 30 days of discovery, or upon the Licensor's express reinstatement. Reinstatement does not affect the Licensor's right to seek remedies for violations.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition reflects automatic termination for noncompliance and does not apply after timely cure or express reinstatement. The clause does not itself specify permissions for activities beyond the Licensed Rights.
